systems.owner: the Siun community, supported by the UK FCDO Digital Access Programme
systems.tiers: one community in Obafemi Owode Local Government Area, Ogun State, inaugurated 2 September 2026; one of 10 hubs, with others in Kaduna, Kwara, Abia and Ogun States

note: A community-owned internet hub for residents; the local government area is only its location, and no local government office is said to be connected.
